_doc: Question marks of every script: the characters whose Unicode name contains QUESTION MARK and that have Terminal_Punctuation=Yes (PropList.txt), in code point order. question_marks_after_script: a question mark whose canonical decomposition is one other character (UnicodeData.txt: U+037E GREEK QUESTION MARK is U+003B SEMICOLON, and NFC writes it so) makes that character a question mark after a letter of the script its name begins with (PropertyValueAliases.txt script names).
_source: generated by scripts/update-unicode-data.sh from the pinned Unicode Character Database and CLDR (unicode-pin.json); edit only the hand-kept keys, then re-run the script
